notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card available.
description:
Cast Mana Severance by paying {1}{U}, exiling all lands from your library.
Cast Recross the Paths by paying {2}{G}, revealing your entire library and reordering it with Collected Company on top and Thassa's Oracle and Undercity Informer directly below it.
Draw a card by any method.
Cast Collected Company by paying {3}{G}, putting Thassa's Oracle and Undercity Informer from your library onto the battlefield.
Thassa's Oracle triggers.
In response to the trigger, activate Undercity Informer by paying {1} and sacrificing itself, milling your library.
Resolve the Thassa's Oracle trigger, winning the game.
